description: This file defines a PHP class PcaConnectorAdClient that extends the AwsClient class, providing a client interface for the PcaConnectorAd service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various operations related to connectors, directory registrations, service principal names, templates, and access control entries.

classes.name: PcaConnectorAdClient
classes.description: A PHP client class to interact with AWS's PcaConnectorAd service, extending the base AwsClient class.
